# dashboard-stats

Key figures on a dashboard: stat panels backed by one counting query.

## README

# Dashboard stats

Key figures on a dashboard. This recipe ships a `ticket` entity, one query
handler that returns the figures as a flat object, and a `dashboard` screen
with a stat group (open, closed) and a single stat (total).

The point is to show how the three pieces connect: the screen only names a
query and the fields to read, the query does the counting.

## What it shows

- **Panels reference a query by qualified name**: each `stat` carries
  `query: "tickets:query:ticket:stats"`. The dashboard calls that handler and
  renders the result.
- **`valueField` picks a field from a flat result**: the handler returns
  `{ open, closed, total }`, and each stat names one of those keys.
- **`stat-group` and `stat`**: a group shows several stats side by side under
  one title, a top-level `stat` stands alone.
- **Counting happens in the database**: the handler calls the executor's
  `list` with `filter`, `limit: 1` and `totalCount: true`. The total is counted
  over the whole WHERE clause, so no rows are loaded just to be counted.
- **Labels are translation keys**: declared with `r.translations`.
- **Record-bound dashboard**: `ticket-record-dashboard` binds to a record with `record`
  and embeds the `ticket-card` projectionDetail as a screen panel; the record id
  becomes its entityId.
- **Gated toolbar button**: `visibleWhen` on a toolbar action asks a flat
  capability query; the button is hidden while it loads or fails.
- **Fallback by reason**: `fallback: { forbidden, notFound }` renders a screen on
  403/404 of the gate query; other reasons get the default notice or an error
  banner with retry.

## When to reach for it

You want a landing screen with a few numbers: open items, overdue invoices,
this month's revenue. Write one query per screen that returns every figure,
and let the stats pick their field.

## Source

The whole feature lives in `src/feature.ts` (~100 lines). The integration test
checks that every stat reads a field the query returns, and that the query
counts open and closed tickets correctly.

```bash
bun kumiko test integration samples/dashboard-stats
```

```ts
// Dashboard Stats Sample, integration test.
// Proves: the dashboard screen boots, its panels point at a registered query,
// and that query counts per status in the database.

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import type { SaveContext } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { createEventsTable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/event-store";
import { createTestUser, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import {
  TICKET_CAPABILITIES_QUERY,
  TICKET_STATS_QUERY,
  ticketEntity,
  ticketFeature,
} from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

const admin = createTestUser({ roles: ["Admin"], tenantId: testTenantId(31) });

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [ticketFeature] });
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, ticketEntity);
  await createEventsTable(stack.db);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

describe("dashboard screen", () => {
  test("boots, and every stat reads a field the stats query returns", async () => {
    const screen = ticketFeature.screens["ticket-dashboard"];
    if (screen?.type !== "dashboard") throw new Error("ticket-dashboard is not a dashboard screen");

    const stats = screen.panels.flatMap((panel) =>
      panel.kind === "stat-group" ? panel.stats : panel.kind === "stat" ? [panel] : [],
    );
    expect(stats.map((s) => s.valueField)).toEqual(["open", "closed", "total"]);
    for (const stat of stats) expect(stat.query).toBe(TICKET_STATS_QUERY);

    const result = await stack.http.queryOk<Record<string, unknown>>(TICKET_STATS_QUERY, {}, admin);
    for (const stat of stats) expect(result).toHaveProperty(stat.valueField);
  });
});

describe("ticket:stats", () => {
  test("counts open and closed tickets in the database", async () => {
    for (const [title, status] of [
      ["a", "open"],
      ["b", "open"],
      ["c", "open"],
      ["d", "closed"],
      ["e", "closed"],
    ] as const) {
      await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
        "tickets:write:ticket:create",
        { title, status },
        admin,
      );
    }

    const result = await stack.http.queryOk<Record<string, unknown>>(TICKET_STATS_QUERY, {}, admin);

    expect(result).toEqual({ open: 3, closed: 2, total: 5 });
  });
});

describe("record-bound dashboard with a gated detail panel", () => {
  test("the dashboard embeds the detail screen and the gate answers per role", async () => {
    const dashboard = ticketFeature.screens["ticket-record-dashboard"];
    if (dashboard?.type !== "dashboard") throw new Error("ticket-record-dashboard missing");
    expect(dashboard.record).toEqual({ param: "ticketId", payloadKey: "id" });
    expect(dashboard.panels.map((panel) => panel.kind)).toEqual(["screen"]);

    const card = ticketFeature.screens["ticket-card"];
    expect(card?.fallback).toEqual({ forbidden: "ticket-list", notFound: "ticket-list" });

    const adminGate = await stack.http.queryOk<{ canClose: boolean }>(
      TICKET_CAPABILITIES_QUERY,
      {},
      admin,
    );
    expect(adminGate.canClose).toBe(true);
    const user = createTestUser({ roles: ["User"], tenantId: testTenantId(31) });
    const userGate = await stack.http.queryOk<{ canClose: boolean }>(
      TICKET_CAPABILITIES_QUERY,
      {},
      user,
    );
    expect(userGate.canClose).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the toolbar button carries the same gate", () => {
    const list = ticketFeature.screens["ticket-list"];
    if (list?.type !== "projectionList") throw new Error("ticket-list missing");
    expect(list.toolbarActions?.[0]?.visibleWhen).toEqual({
      query: TICKET_CAPABILITIES_QUERY,
      field: "canClose",
      eq: true,
    });
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Dashboard Stats Sample
// Shows: a dashboard screen with a stat-group and a single stat, backed by one
// query handler that counts in the database. A second, record-bound dashboard embeds a
// projectionDetail as a panel, hides a toolbar button behind a capability query, and picks its
// fallback screen by the reason the gate closed.

import {
  createEntity,
  createEntityExecutor,
  createSelectField,
  createTextField,
  defineFeature,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { z } from "zod";

export const TICKET_STATUSES = ["open", "closed"] as const;

export const ticketEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_sample_tickets",
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    status: createSelectField({ options: TICKET_STATUSES, default: "open", required: true }),
  },
});

export const TICKET_STATS_QUERY = "tickets:query:ticket:stats";
export const TICKET_CAPABILITIES_QUERY = "tickets:query:ticket:capabilities";

const readerRoles = { roles: ["Admin", "User"] } as const;

export const ticketFeature = defineFeature("tickets", (r) => {
  const { executor: ticketExecutor } = createEntityExecutor("ticket", ticketEntity);

  r.crud("ticket", ticketEntity, {
    write: { access: { roles: ["Admin"] } },
    read: { access: readerRoles },
  });

  // Flat result: each dashboard stat reads one field via its valueField.
  // limit: 1 keeps the page tiny; totalCount counts over the whole WHERE in
  // the database, so no rows are loaded just to be counted.
  r.queryHandler({
    name: "ticket:stats",
    schema: z.object({}),
    handler: async (query, ctx) => {
      const countWithStatus = async (status: (typeof TICKET_STATUSES)[number]): Promise<number> => {
        const page = await ticketExecutor.list(
          { filter: { field: "status", op: "eq", value: status }, limit: 1, totalCount: true },
          query.user,
          ctx.db,
        );
        return page.total ?? 0;
      };
      const [open, closed] = await Promise.all([
        countWithStatus("open"),
        countWithStatus("closed"),
      ]);
      return { open, closed, total: open + closed };
    },
    access: readerRoles,
  });

  // Gate for the screens below: a flat answer with one boolean the screens test with `eq`.
  r.queryHandler({
    name: "ticket:capabilities",
    schema: z.object({}),
    outputSchema: z.object({ canClose: z.boolean() }),
    handler: async (query) => ({ canClose: query.user.roles.includes("Admin") }),
    access: readerRoles,
  });

  r.queryHandler({
    name: "ticket:card",
    schema: z.object({ id: z.string() }),
    handler: async (query, ctx) => {
      const page = await ticketExecutor.list(
        { filter: { field: "id", op: "eq", value: query.payload.id }, limit: 1 },
        query.user,
        ctx.db,
      );
      const ticket = page.rows[0];
      return { id: query.payload.id, title: ticket?.title ?? "", status: ticket?.status ?? "" };
    },
    access: readerRoles,
  });

  r.queryHandler({
    name: "ticket:rows",
    schema: z.object({}),
    handler: async (query, ctx) => {
      const page = await ticketExecutor.list({ limit: 50 }, query.user, ctx.db);
      return { rows: page.rows, nextCursor: null };
    },
    access: readerRoles,
  });

  r.translations({
    keys: {
      "screen:ticket-list.title": { en: "Tickets" },
      "screen:ticket-card.title": { en: "Ticket" },
      "screen:ticket-record-dashboard.title": { en: "Ticket overview" },
      "entity:ticket:field:title": { en: "Title" },
      "entity:ticket:field:status": { en: "Status" },
      "entity:__projection-detail__:field:title": { en: "Title" },
      "entity:__projection-detail__:field:status": { en: "Status" },
      "tickets.toolbar.close": { en: "Close all done" },
      "tickets.dashboard.card": { en: "Ticket" },
      "tickets.dashboard.group": { en: "Tickets by status" },
      "tickets.dashboard.open": { en: "Open" },
      "tickets.dashboard.closed": { en: "Closed" },
      "tickets.dashboard.total": { en: "All tickets" },
    },
  });

  r.screen({
    id: "ticket-dashboard",
    type: "dashboard",
    panels: [
      {
        kind: "stat-group",
        id: "by-status",
        label: "tickets.dashboard.group",
        stats: [
          {
            kind: "stat",
            id: "open",
            label: "tickets.dashboard.open",
            query: TICKET_STATS_QUERY,
            valueField: "open",
          },
          {
            kind: "stat",
            id: "closed",
            label: "tickets.dashboard.closed",
            query: TICKET_STATS_QUERY,
            valueField: "closed",
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        kind: "stat",
        id: "total",
        label: "tickets.dashboard.total",
        query: TICKET_STATS_QUERY,
        valueField: "total",
      },
    ],
    access: readerRoles,
  });

  // Three additions: a projectionDetail embedded in a record-bound dashboard, a gated toolbar
  // button, and a fallback chosen by reason.
  const gate = { query: TICKET_CAPABILITIES_QUERY, field: "canClose", eq: true } as const;

  // The list doubles as the fallback target: it has no visibleWhen of its own.
  r.screen({
    id: "ticket-list",
    type: "projectionList",
    query: "tickets:query:ticket:rows",
    columns: ["title", "status"],
    access: readerRoles,
    toolbarActions: [
      {
        kind: "writeHandler",
        id: "close-done",
        label: "tickets.toolbar.close",
        handler: "tickets:write:ticket:update",
        // Live and fail-closed: hidden while the query loads and when it fails.
        visibleWhen: gate,
      },
    ],
  });

  r.screen({
    id: "ticket-card",
    type: "projectionDetail",
    query: "tickets:query:ticket:card",
    layout: { sections: [{ title: "tickets.dashboard.card", fields: ["title", "status"] }] },
    access: readerRoles,
    visibleWhen: gate,
    // 403 and 404 on the gate query get their own screen; an unmet condition keeps the
    // default notice and any other failure shows an error banner with retry.
    fallback: { forbidden: "ticket-list", notFound: "ticket-list" },
  });

  // `record` reads the id from the URL; the embedded projectionDetail receives it as its entityId.
  r.screen({
    id: "ticket-record-dashboard",
    type: "dashboard",
    record: { param: "ticketId", payloadKey: "id" },
    panels: [{ kind: "screen", id: "card", screen: "ticket-card" }],
    access: readerRoles,
  });
});
```
